what: The product owner's answers of 23 October 2026 to the points the M0 decisions of 22 October 2026 left open, as the workflow that ran the follow-up round relayed them, verbatim, to that round (integration log section 20). The owner gave them in conversation with the orchestrating session; that conversation is outside this repository, and no other copy is committed. The workflow called them authoritative and asked that each be recorded wherever the records listed it as open, waiting or to confirm. Each entry gives the answer as relayed, the open items it settles as the records had them at a1ea66d2, and where this round recorded it. A decision is not a device result: nothing here changes a device or human step's status.
relayed_to: the follow-up round of the M0 decisions round (branch m0-decisions, from a1ea66d2), 23 October 2026
